程序包 dao

类 ApplicationDAO

java.lang.Object
dao.ApplicationDAO
public class ApplicationDAO extends Object
Data access object for job applications stored in data/applications.csv.

Provides methods to save, read, filter by TA or job, check duplicates, and update application status (including rejection reason).
